summary: Backend-only verification of RDP Grace Auto-Destroy (Phase D reseller API + Phase E unit tests). All 4 node unit suites pass with exact expected counts (64/91/44/34), `npm run lint:lang` clean (all 3 target locales in parity). Wrote a new HTTP smoke suite that hits the live sandbox reseller API and confirms: /health dry_run, /account owner match, /rdp list + credentials, GET /renewals surfaces grace fields (status='grace', in_grace=true, expired_at, delete_at, days_until_deletion=2, summary.in_grace>=1), GET /rdp/:id returns grace block for EXPIRED_GRACE + status='destroyed' + destroy_reason='expired_grace' for cancelled/expired_grace record, and POST /rdp/:id/renew dry_run pricing exactly matches spec ($56/$100.8/$142.8 for months=1/2/3), months clamped to 1..3, unknown id => 404 not_found, grace-destroyed record => 409 already_destroyed, sufficient_balance=true with funded wallet. Only 1 minor gap: GET /rdp/plans does not return `os_options`.

minor.issue: Response does not include `os_options` field. Body shape is {product, provider:'azure', region, plans:[{plan_id,name,vcpus,ram_gb,disk_gb,price_usd}]} — Phase D review request explicitly listed 'lists plans + os_options' as part of the reseller regression, but the current handler omits Windows OS choices. Not part of the new grace/renew work but flagged for completeness.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Decide whether GET /api/reseller/v1/rdp/plans should include `os_options` (e.g., available Windows Server images). If yes, add it to the handler in js/reseller-api.js; otherwise update the Phase D spec/docs to remove the os_options expectation.
critical_code_review_comments: State machine (js/rdp-grace-lifecycle.js) is nicely pure with injected deps — good testability.
Reseller API renew handler correctly gates already-destroyed records with 409 + explanatory message, and 404 for unknowns.
Dry-run pricing calculation matches golden-tier bundle discount table exactly (56 / 100.8 / 142.8) — no off-by-one in months clamping (0 => 1, 99 => 3 both verified live).
RDP-service Sweep-2 destroy path is only covered by unit test on this sandbox (SKIP_WEBHOOK_SYNC=true gates the bot scheduler); the safety-net path is well-exercised against the fake DO API stub.
